verdict_statement: The pinned FLEXPART 11.1 GRIB2 CP divisor of 1000 is a compensation for the ecCodes 2.24.2 GRIB1->GRIB2 concept of ECMWF paramId 143 (discipline 0, category 1, number 10, unitsFactor = 1000), which multiplies the flex_extract mm/h CP values by 1000 and relabels them acpcp (paramId 3063, kg m**-2). For flex_extract 7.1.2 FORMAT=GRIB2 output converted by ecCodes 2.24.2 and read by FLEXPART linked against ecCodes 2.24.2, the reader stores CP and LSP in the mm/h that interpol_rain and wetdepo expect: CORRECT_AS_PREPARED. The result depends on the producer's ecCodes definitions; ecCodes 2.50.0 maps LSP/CP to local 0/1/196 and 0/1/195 without scaling, and the pinned reader then stops in gridcheck_ecmwf. No reference defect is confirmed and none is corrected.

reader_crosswalk.asymmetry_explanation: ecCodes 2.24.2 encodes paramId 142 in the ECMWF local table (192/128/142, no unitsFactor) but paramId 143 as WMO 0/1/10 with unitsFactor 1000. FLEXPART divides only the WMO-numbered CP message, which is the one ecCodes scaled. The asymmetry is an intentional-looking compensation for an upstream encoder conversion, conditional on the ecCodes definitions; it is not a difference in prepared physical representation.

grib2_eccodes_2.24.2_decoded.cp: 1000 x mm/h (label kg m**-2, paramId 3063 acpcp, 0/1/10)

units_by_stage_executed.packing: simple packing, 24 bits, decimalScaleFactor 0 in both editions; the CP binaryScaleFactor changes from -24 (GRIB1) to -14 (GRIB2) only because the encoded range grew by 1000. Binary scaling is not the unit conversion.

measured_divisor_effect.statement: In the executed ecCodes 2.24.2 GRIB2 file the decoded CP is 1000 times the prepared mm/h value (power-of-1000 exponent 1 on every nonzero row). The reader divisor returns it to exponent 0. Stored GRIB2 CP equals stored GRIB1 CP within the #71 policy (max absolute difference 2.235e-08 mm/h, from re-packing), and stored GRIB2 LSP equals stored GRIB1 LSP exactly.
measured_divisor_effect.without_divisor: CP would be stored 1000 times too large (e.g. 200.00006 instead of 0.2 mm/h at node 0,0 on 2023-11-01 12 UTC)
measured_divisor_effect.divisor_without_eccodes_scaling: Not reached by any executed original input: the ecCodes 2.50.0 CP message (0/1/195, m, unscaled) does not match the CP branch at all.

handoff_32.conversion_ownership: For the accepted GRIB2 class the decoder divides the decoded 0/1/10 CP values by exactly 1000 as the explicit inverse of the producer ecCodes unitsFactor, records that conversion with its producer identity in provenance, and keeps LSP unscaled. It must not apply the factor because of the units label, the WMO table or the FLEXPART source alone.

out_of_scope_observations: ecCodes 2.24.2 encodes snow depth (paramId 141) as 0/1/254, so the GRIB2 SD branch (0/1/11, /1000) never matches flex_extract GRIB2 output; the reader logs 'undefined GRiB2 message' and leaves sd unread.
The GRIB2 messages carry productDefinitionTemplateNumber 8 with typeOfStatisticalProcessing 0 (average) and stepRange 0 for point rates; the reader ignores these keys apart from stepRange.
